ABOUT THIS COLLECTION

The Authorized King James Version

This app uses the traditional KJV text across the 66 books of the Old and New Testaments. It does not include the Apocrypha.

There is no single universally designated “latest KJV.” Publishers offer different editions; the text here is the traditional KJV dataset linked below, not a claim to a particular publisher’s newest edition.

5,000 questions. A verse for every answer.

The collection combines original Bible-fact questions with verse-recall questions assembled from the text.

Verse-recall questions ask about names, places, numbers, missing words, and books. These check the wording of the quoted passage. The complete bank has not received an independent human editorial review.

KJV text source · Question bank included in the ZIP

Questions are bundled with this app. No AI service is called while you play. Scores and progress are stored only in this browser.
